mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_WS_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO WORKSPACES ( WS_ID, WS_NAME, INVITE_CODE, OWNER_ID, WS_IMAGE_PATH, WS_DESCRIPTION, WS_TYPE, JOIN_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{wsId}, #{wsName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inviteCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownerId}, #{wsImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{wsDescription, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{wsType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{joinType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT W.WS_ID, W.WS_NAME, W.INVITE_CODE, W.OWNER_ID, W.WS_IMAGE_PATH, W.WS_DESCRIPTION, W.WS_TYPE, W.JOIN_TYPE, NVL(W.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(W.DELETE_REQUESTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DELETE_REQUESTED_AT, TO_CHAR(W.DELETE_DEADLINE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DELETE_DEADLINE_AT FROM WORKSPACES W JOIN WS_MEMBERS M ON W.WS_ID = M.WS_ID WHERE M.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY W.WS_ID DESC

SELECT WS_ID, WS_NAME, INVITE_CODE, OWNER_ID, WS_IMAGE_PATH, WS_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, WS_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE, WS_IMAGE_CROP_X, WS_IMAGE_CROP_Y, WS_DESCRIPTION, WS_TYPE, JOIN_TYPE, NVL(STATUS, 'ACTIVE') AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(DELETE_REQUESTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DELETE_REQUESTED_AT, TO_CHAR(DELETE_DEADLINE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DELETE_DEADLINE_AT FROM WORKSPACES WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WS_MEMBERS ( WS_MEM_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, WS_ROLE, JOINED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_WS_MEM_ID.NEXTVAL, #{wsId}, #{userId}, #{role}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT m.WS_MEM_ID, m.WS_ROLE, u.USER_ID, p.CONTACT_EMAIL AS CUSTOM_CONTACT_EMAIL, NVL(p.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) AS EMAIL, CASE WHEN NVL(p.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(p.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS DISPLAY_NAME, CASE WHEN NVL(p.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN p.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, p.POSITION_NAME, TO_CHAR(m.JOINED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JOINED_AT FROM WS_MEMBERS m JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = m.WS_ID JOIN USERS u ON m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES p ON p.WS_ID = m.WS_ID AND p.USER_ID = m.USER_ID WHERE m.WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.USER_ID = w.OWNER_ID THEN 1 WHEN m.WS_ROLE = 'ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, DISPLAY_NAME ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND USER_ID = #{inviteeId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WS_INVITATIONS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND INVITEE_ID = #{inviteeId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING') ) FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WS_INVITATIONS ( INVITE_ID, WS_ID, INVITER_ID, INVITEE_ID, STATUS, SENT_AT ) SELECT GREATEST( SEQ_INVITE_ID.NEXTVAL, NVL((SELECT MAX(INVITE_ID) + 1 FROM WS_INVITATIONS), 1) ), #{wsId}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT i.INVITE_ID, w.WS_NAME, u.USER_NAME as INVITER_NAME, i.STATUS FROM WS_INVITATIONS i JOIN WORKSPACES w ON i.WS_ID = w.WS_ID JOIN USERS u ON i.INVITER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE i.INVITEE_ID = #{userId} AND i.STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE WS_INVITATIONS SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE INVITE_ID = #{inviteId}
mapper.select: SELECT WS_ID, INVITEE_ID FROM WS_INVITATIONS WHERE INVITE_ID = #{inviteId}

SELECT m.USER_ID AS "USER_ID", m.USER_ID AS "userId", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "USER_NAME", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "userName", NVL(wp.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) AS "EMAIL", NVL(wp.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) AS "email", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS "PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS "profileImagePath", m.WS_ROLE AS "WS_ROLE", m.WS_ROLE AS "wsRole", wp.POSITION_NAME AS "WS_POSITION", wp.POSITION_NAME AS "wsPosition", TO_CHAR(m.JOINED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "JOINED_AT", TO_CHAR(m.JOINED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "joinedAt" FROM WS_MEMBERS m JOIN USERS u ON m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES wp ON wp.WS_ID = m.WS_ID AND wp.USER_ID = m.USER_ID WHERE m.WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.WS_ROLE = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, "USER_NAME"
mapper.update: UPDATE WORKSPACES SET STATUS = 'DELETE_PENDING', DELETE_REQUESTED_AT = SYSDATE, DELETE_DEADLINE_AT = SYSDATE + 30 WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND OWNER_ID = #{ownerId} AND NVL(STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE WORKSPACES SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', DELETE_REQUESTED_AT = NULL, DELETE_DEADLINE_AT = NULL WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND OWNER_ID = #{ownerId} AND STATUS = 'DELETE_PENDING' AND DELETE_DEADLINE_AT >= SYSDATE
mapper.select: SELECT WS_ID FROM WORKSPACES WHERE STATUS = 'DELETE_PENDING' AND DELETE_DEADLINE_AT < SYSDATE ORDER BY DELETE_DEADLINE_AT
SELECT EVENT_ID as "eventId", TITLE as "title", TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "startDt", EVENT_COLOR as "color" FROM EVENTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY START_DT ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POSTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND PROJ_ID IS NULL AND BOARD_TYPE = 'NOTICE') AS "noticeCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POSTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND PROJ_ID IS NULL AND BOARD_TYPE = 'FREE') AS "freeCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POSTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND PROJ_ID IS NULL AND BOARD_TYPE = 'FILE') AS "fileCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POLLS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND SCOPE = 'WORKSPACE' AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (END_DT IS NULL OR END_DT >= SYSDATE)) AS "activePollCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND TRUNC(START_DT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS "todayEventCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId}) AS "projectCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId}) AS "memberCount" FROM DUAL

SELECT ACT_TYPE, TITLE, USER_NAME, REG_DT_TEXT FROM ( SELECT p.BOARD_TYPE AS ACT_TYPE, p.TITLE AS TITLE, u.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS REG_DT_TEXT, p.REG_DT AS SORT_DT FROM BOARD_POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.PROJ_ID IS NULL AND p.BOARD_TYPE IN ('NOTICE', 'FREE', 'FILE')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'POLL' AS ACT_TYPE, p.QUESTION AS TITLE, u.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS REG_DT_TEXT, p.REG_DT AS SORT_DT FROM POLLS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.SCOPE = 'WORKSPACE' ) ORDER BY SORT_DT DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT e.TITLE AS "title", CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'HH24:MI') = '00:00' THEN '종일' ELSE TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'HH24:MI') END AS "time", e.ITEM_TYPE AS "itemType", CASE WHEN e.ITEM_TYPE = 'PRIVATE' THEN '개인' WHEN e.ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' THEN '프로젝트' WHEN e.ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK' THEN '프로젝트' WHEN e.ITEM_TYPE = 'WS' THEN '그룹' WHEN e.ITEM_TYPE = 'HOLIDAY' THEN '공휴일' ELSE '일정' END AS "typeLabel" FROM EVENTS e WHERE e.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND TRUNC(e.START_DT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY e.START_DT ASC
SELECT poll_id, question FROM polls WHERE ws_id = #{wsId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT o.OPTION_ID, o.TEXT, COUNT(v.VOTE_ID) as COUNT FROM POLL_OPTIONS o LEFT JOIN VOTES v ON o.OPTION_ID = v.OPTION_ID WHERE o.POLL_ID = #{pollId} GROUP BY o.OPTION_ID, o.TEXT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO votes (vote_id, poll_id, option_id, user_id) VALUES (SEQ_VOTE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{pollId}, #{optionId}, #{userId})

MERGE INTO WS_MEMBER_PROFILES p USING (SELECT #{wsId} AS WS_ID, #{userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL) src ON (p.WS_ID = src.WS_ID AND p.USER_ID = src.USER_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( WS_ID, USER_ID, USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, SHOW_PHONE, SHOW_BIRTH, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( src.WS_ID, src.USER_ID, 'Y', 'N', 'Y', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT m.USER_ID, m.WS_ROLE, CASE WHEN w.OWNER_ID = m.USER_ID THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_OWNER, u.EMAIL AS ACCOUNT_EMAIL, p.CONTACT_EMAIL AS CUSTOM_CONTACT_EMAIL, NVL(p.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) AS EMAIL, u.USER_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS ACCOUNT_PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH AS ACCOUNT_PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, 1) AS ACCOUNT_PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_X, 0) AS ACCOUNT_PROFILE_CROP_X, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_Y, 0) AS ACCOUNT_PROFILE_CROP_Y, NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') AS ACCOUNT_PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, NVL(p.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE, 1) AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(p.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X, 0) AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X, NVL(p.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y, 0) AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y, CASE WHEN NVL(p.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(p.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS DISPLAY_NAME, p.DISPLAY_NAME AS CUSTOM_DISPLAY_NAME, CASE WHEN NVL(p.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN p.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, p.POSITION_NAME, CASE WHEN m.USER_ID = #{viewerUserId} OR NVL(p.SHOW_PHONE, 'N') = 'Y' THEN p.PHONE_NUMBER ELSE NULL END AS PHONE_NUMBER, NVL(p.SHOW_PHONE, 'N') AS SHOW_PHONE, NVL(p.SHOW_BIRTH, 'Y') AS SHOW_BIRTH, NVL(p.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') AS USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, TO_CHAR(m.JOINED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JOINED_AT, CASE WHEN NVL(p.SHOW_BIRTH, 'Y') = 'Y' THEN TO_CHAR(u.BIRTH_DATE, 'MM-DD') ELSE NULL END AS BIRTH_DATE, CASE WHEN NVL(p.SHOW_BIRTH, 'Y') = 'Y' THEN NVL(u.BIRTH_CALENDAR_TYPE, 'SOLAR') ELSE NULL END AS BIRTH_CALENDAR_TYPE FROM WS_MEMBERS m JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = m.WS_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = m.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES p ON p.WS_ID = m.WS_ID AND p.USER_ID = m.USER_ID WHERE m.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND m.USER_ID = #{targetUserId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS viewer WHERE viewer.WS_ID = m.WS_ID AND viewer.USER_ID = #{viewerUserId} )

SELECT p.WS_ID, p.USER_ID, NVL(p.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') AS USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, p.DISPLAY_NAME AS CUSTOM_DISPLAY_NAME, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, NVL(p.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE, 1) AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(p.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X, 0) AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X, NVL(p.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y, 0) AS CUSTOM_PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y, p.CONTACT_EMAIL, p.POSITION_NAME, p.PHONE_NUMBER, NVL(p.SHOW_PHONE, 'N') AS SHOW_PHONE, NVL(p.SHOW_BIRTH, 'Y') AS SHOW_BIRTH FROM WS_MEMBER_PROFILES p WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE WS_MEMBER_PROFILES SET USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE = #{useAccountProfile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DISPLAY_NAME = #{displayName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH = CASE WHEN #{removeProfileImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE( #{profileImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ) END, PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH = CASE WHEN #{removeProfileImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE( #{profileImageOriginalPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH ) END, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE = CASE WHEN #{removeProfileImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE( #{profileImageCropScale, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE ) END, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X = CASE WHEN #{removeProfileImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE( #{profileImageCropX, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X ) END, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y = CASE WHEN #{removeProfileImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE( #{profileImageCropY, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y ) END, CONTACT_EMAIL = #{contactEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, POSITION_NAME = #{positionName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PHONE_NUMBER = #{phoneNumber, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SHOW_PHONE = #{showPhone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SHOW_BIRTH = #{showBirth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WS_MEMBER_PROFILES ( WS_ID, USER_ID, USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, DISPLAY_NAME, PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X, PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y, CONTACT_EMAIL, POSITION_NAME, PHONE_NUMBER, SHOW_PHONE, SHOW_BIRTH, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{wsId}, #{userId}, #{useAccountProfile}, #{displayName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileImageOriginalPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileImageCropScale, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileImageCropX, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileImageCropY, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{contactEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{positionName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phoneNumber, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{showPhone}, #{showBirth}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT LINK_ID, WS_ID, LINK_NAME, LINK_URL, SORT_ORDER FROM WORKSPACE_LINKS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, LINK_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WORKSPACE_LINKS ( LINK_ID, WS_ID, LINK_NAME, LINK_URL, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_WS_LINK_ID.NEXTVAL, #{wsId}, #{linkName}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrder}, SYSDATE )

MERGE INTO WS_MEMBER_PROFILES p USING ( SELECT #{wsId} AS WS_ID, #{userId} AS USER_ID, #{positionName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS POSITION_NAME FROM DUAL ) src ON ( p.WS_ID = src.WS_ID AND p.USER_ID = src.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.POSITION_NAME = src.POSITION_NAME, p.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( WS_ID, USER_ID, USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, POSITION_NAME, SHOW_PHONE, SHOW_BIRTH, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( src.WS_ID, src.USER_ID, 'Y', src.POSITION_NAME, 'N', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES ( ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, ALERT_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_READ, REG_DT ) SELECT SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, recipients.USER_ID, NULL, 'GROUP_JOIN_REQUEST', 'GROUP', #{wsId}, w.WS_NAME || ' 참여 요청', u.USER_NAME || '님이 그룹 참여를 요청했습니다.', '/workspace/settings?wsId=' || #{wsId} || '&tab=members', 'N', SYSDATE FROM ( SELECT OWNER_ID AS USER_ID FROM WORKSPACES WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} UNION SELECT USER_ID FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} AND WS_ROLE = 'ADMIN' ) recipients JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = #{wsId} JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE recipients.USER_ID <> #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_NOTICES un WHERE un.ALERT_TYPE = 'GROUP_JOIN_REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WS_JOIN_REQUESTS r JOIN USERS requester ON requester.USER_ID = r.REQUESTER_ID JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = r.WS_ID WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND un.TARGET_TYPE = 'GROUP' AND un.TARGET_ID = r.WS_ID AND un.CONTENT = requester.USER_NAME || '님이 그룹 참여를 요청했습니다.' AND ( un.USER_ID = w.OWNER_ID OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS admin_member WHERE admin_member.WS_ID = r.WS_ID AND admin_member.USER_ID = un.USER_ID AND admin_member.WS_ROLE = 'ADMIN' ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT r.REQUEST_ID AS "requestId", r.WS_ID AS "wsId", w.WS_NAME AS "wsName", r.REQUESTER_ID AS "requesterId", u.USER_NAME AS "requesterName", u.EMAIL AS "requesterEmail", u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS "requesterProfileImage", r.REQUESTED_AT AS "requestedAt", r.STATUS AS "status" FROM WS_JOIN_REQUESTS r JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = r.WS_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.REQUESTER_ID WHERE r.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND (w.OWNER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS m WHERE m.WS_ID = r.WS_ID AND m.USER_ID = #{userId} AND m.WS_ROLE = 'ADMIN' )) ORDER BY r.REQUESTED_AT ASC, r.REQUEST_ID ASC

SELECT r.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, r.WS_ID AS wsId, r.REQUESTER_ID AS requesterId, r.STATUS AS status, w.WS_NAME AS wsName, w.OWNER_ID AS ownerId FROM WS_JOIN_REQUESTS r JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = r.WS_ID WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE WS_JOIN_REQUESTS SET STATUS = #{status}, REVIEWER_ID = #{reviewerId}, REVIEWED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_NOTICES un WHERE un.ALERT_TYPE IN ( 'GROUP_JOIN_APPROVED', 'GROUP_JOIN_REJECTED', 'GROUP_JOIN_COMPLETED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WS_JOIN_REQUESTS r WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND r.REQUESTER_ID = un.USER_ID AND r.WS_ID = un.TARGET_ID )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES ( ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, ALERT_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_READ, REG_DT ) SELECT SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, r.REQUESTER_ID, NULL, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN 'GROUP_JOIN_APPROVED' ELSE 'GROUP_JOIN_REJECTED' END, 'GROUP', r.WS_ID, w.WS_NAME || CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN ' 참여 요청 승인' ELSE ' 참여 요청 거절' END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN '참여 요청이 승인되었습니다. 프로필을 설정하면 그룹에 참여할 수 있습니다.' ELSE CASE WHEN #{rejectionReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL THEN '이번에는 그룹 참여가 승인되지 않았습니다. 사유: ' || #{rejectionReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ELSE '이번에는 그룹 참여가 승인되지 않았습니다.' END END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN '/requests?approvedJoinRequestId=' || r.REQUEST_ID ELSE '/requests?rejectedJoinRequestId=' || r.REQUEST_ID END, 'N', SYSDATE FROM WS_JOIN_REQUESTS r JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = r.WS_ID WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_NOTICES un WHERE un.USER_ID = r.REQUESTER_ID AND un.ALERT_TYPE = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN 'GROUP_JOIN_APPROVED' ELSE 'GROUP_JOIN_REJECTED' END AND un.LINK_URL = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN '/requests?approvedJoinRequestId=' || r.REQUEST_ID ELSE '/requests?rejectedJoinRequestId=' || r.REQUEST_ID END )

INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES ( ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, ALERT_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_READ, REG_DT ) SELECT SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, r.REQUESTER_ID, NULL, 'GROUP_JOIN_CANCELLED', 'GROUP', r.WS_ID, w.WS_NAME || ' 참여 포기', '승인된 그룹 참여를 포기했습니다. 다시 참여하려면 새로 요청해주세요.', '/requests', 'Y', SYSDATE FROM WS_JOIN_REQUESTS r JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = r.WS_ID WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}

INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES ( ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, ALERT_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_READ, REG_DT ) SELECT SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, r.REQUESTER_ID, NULL, 'GROUP_JOIN_COMPLETED', 'GROUP', r.WS_ID, w.WS_NAME || ' 참여 완료', '그룹 프로필 설정과 참여가 완료되었습니다.', '/workspace/main?wsId=' || r.WS_ID, 'Y', SYSDATE FROM WS_JOIN_REQUESTS r JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = r.WS_ID WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
